remarks: Chic & Bright Alcove Jr Suite in Prime Stamford Location! This beautifully updated apartment offers comfort, charm, and unbeatable convenience in the heart of Stamford. Enjoy an open and airy layout with abundant natural light, durable Pergo flooring, a stylish kitchen with modern finishes and ample cabinet space, and freshly painted walls in Simply White for a crisp, contemporary feel. The cozy sleeping nook provides a peaceful retreat, while a private balcony offers sweeping city views. Located in a secure building, this apt also features heat, hot water, and cooking gas, as well as a reserved parking space. Just one block from UConn Stamford and close to shopping, the library, dining, and public transportation, it's a perfect place to call home with low-maintenance living in a vibrant neighborhood- live, work, and relax, all steps away!
